_description: Permanently delete your League & Tournament Maker account and all associated data.
title: Delete Account
subtitle: Sign in with your email and password, then type the confirmation phrase to permanently delete your account and all associated data.
info1_li2: Authentication credentials linked to the account
info1_li4: Any user-associated app preferences and settings
info2_desc: All personal data is permanently deleted after account deletion. No personal data is retained. We do not keep any copy of your data; there is no retention period after deletion.
info3_desc: Deletion is processed immediately after successful confirmation. Your account and data are removed as soon as you complete the form.
hint: You must type exactly I confirm (in English, case-insensitive). This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
msg_invalid: Invalid email or password. Please try again.
msg_wrong_phrase: Confirmation phrase is incorrect. Please type exactly: I confirm
msg_api_error: We could not complete account deletion right now. Please try again later.
msg_success:
Your account deletion request was completed successfully.
Deleted data: account profile, authentication credentials, and all tournament/league records linked to this account.
